summary: NatWest Group plc files Form 6-K announcing completion of its acquisition of Evelyn Partners for an enterprise value of £2.7 billion, closed June 30, 2026. The deal creates the UK's leading Private Banking and Wealth Management business, combining Evelyn's £69 billion AUMA with NatWest's £59 billion. Estimated cost synergies of £100 million annually are expected, with £150 million in one-time costs. The transaction is expected to be accretive to Return on Tangible Equity in the first year. Integration will be seamless for customers; no immediate service changes. Watch for interim results July 31, 2026 for full-year guidance impact.
